paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: Evaluation of our models and LLaMA-3-8B-inst.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the performance scores of two models, "LLaMA-3-8B-it" and "Ours (Iterative RLHF)," across six datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis displays the dataset and metric names, listed in the order cSM-8K, MMMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBpp, LC-ApacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis, labeled "Score (%)", represents the performance metric, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80 and tick labels at increments of 10. The LLaMA-3-8B-it model is represented by blue bars, while the "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" model is represented by orange bars. The shortest blue bar, corresponding to the Chat-Arena-Hard dataset, has a value of approximately 12%, while the tallest blue bar, associated with the cSM-8K dataset, reaches a value of approximately 73%. The shortest orange bar, for Chat-Arena-Hard, is close to 20%, and the tallest orange bar, corresponding to cSM-8K, has a value of approximately 70%. The bars are not explicitly sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized, such as through shading or bolding.
